apocalypse/22/4.text: And they ſhal ſec his face: and his name in their foreheads.

apocalypse/22/5.text: Andꝰ night ſhal be no more: and they. ſhal not need the light of lamp, nor the light of the ſunne, becauſe our Lord God doth illuminate them, and they ſhal reigne for euer and̓ euer.

apocalypse/22/7.text: And behold come quickly. Bleſſed is he that keepeth the words ofthe prophecie of this booke.

apocalypse/22/8.text: And l Iohn which haue heard, and feen theſe things. Andⁿ after I had heard and ſeen. I fel downeʳ: to adore before the feet of the Angel which ſhewed me theſe things;

apocalypse/22/9.text: and he ſaid to me: See thou doe not. An. for I am thy fellow. ſeruant, and ofthy brethren the Prophets, and of adore them that keep the words ofthis booke. Adore God.

apocalypse/22/10.text: And he ſaith to me: Seale not the words of the prophecie of this booke. For the time is neer.

apocalypse/22/11.text: He that hurteth, let him. hurt yet: and he that is in filth. let him be filthie yet: and he that is iuſt, clet him be iuſtified yet: and let the holy be ſanctified yet.

apocalypse/22/12.text: Behold l come quickly. And my rewvard is wvith me,ᵏ to render to euery manʳid accordingto his workes.

apocalypse/22/13.text: I amˣ Alpha and Omega, the firſt and the laſt, the beginning and the end.

apocalypse/22/14.text: Bleſſed are they that waſh their ſtoles: that their power may be in the trec of life, and they may enter by the gates intothe citie.

apocalypse/22/15.text: Without are dogges and ſorcerers, and the vnchaſt, and murderers, and ſeruers ofldols, eueryone that loueth and maketh a lie.

apocalypse/22/16.text: I IESVs haue ſent mine Angel, to teſtifie to you theſe things in repai. the Churches. I am the root and ſtocke of Dauid, the bright and mor¬ ning ſtarre.

apocalypse/22/17.text: And the Spirit the bride ſay, Come. And he that hea¬ reth, let him ſay, Come. Andˣ he that thirſteth, let him come: and he that wil, let him take the wvater oflife gratis.

apocalypse/22/18.text: of this booke,/ If auy man ſhul adde to theſe things, Cod ſhal adde vpon him the plagues written in this booke.

apocalypse/22/19.text: And if any man ſhal diminiſh ofthe words of the booke of this prophecie: Cod ſhal take away his part out of thebooke of life, and out ofthe holy citie, and of theſe things that be written in this booke,

apocalypse/22/20.text: ſaith he that giueth teſti¬ monie of theſe things. Yea I come quickely: Amen. Come Lord IESVS.

apocalypse/22/21.text: The grace of our Lord IEs Vs Chriſt be with you al. Amen.

matthew/2/10.text: and amendment, but contrition, ot ſorow ſor the oftence.
